name: BrowserStack Automate API
tagline: REST API for plan, browser inventory, builds, sessions, and logs on BrowserStack Automate.
description: BrowserStack Automate exposes HTTPS REST APIs at api.browserstack.com for programmatic access to your cloud test infrastructure: plan/parallel capacity, full OS-browser-device inventory, projects, builds, sessions, access-key reset, media uploads, and session logs (text, network/HAR, console, Selenium, Appium). Responses are JSON by default. Authentication is HTTP Basic Auth with account username and access key. Related product APIs (App Automate, Test Management, etc.) use different hosts or paths.

auth.details: HTTP Basic Auth: curl -u "YOUR_USERNAME:YOUR_ACCESS_KEY". Username and access key from Automate dashboard or Account Settings; self-serve free trial or paid plan signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No permanent free Automate REST tier. Free trial (signup): ~60 mins Automate per official FAQ (signup page also lists 100 mins automated browser testing), plus Live/App Live minutes and Percy 5,000 screenshots/mo.
pricing.paid_plans: Automate priced per parallel: Chrome Desktop from ~$59/mo, Desktop from ~$99/mo (billed annually); Desktop & Mobile and enterprise higher. Live manual from ~$29/user/mo.

rate_limits: Automate API: 1600 requests per 5 minutes per user; 160 requests per second per IP. (Other products differ, e.g. Test Management 300 req/min.)
use_cases: list available OS, browser, and real-device combinations for test config
check Automate plan parallel limits, running sessions, and queue depth
list or delete builds and projects for a test account
fetch a session’s status, video URL, and debug log links
download session text, network (HAR), console, or Selenium logs
reset the account access key via the Access Key API
